name: recipe-builders-one-world
description: Recipe variant: the builders' /gamemode only in one world, via a LuckPerms world context (tested with world_nether).

steps.console: lp user Bot parent add builder
lp group builder permission set minecraft.command.gamemode true world=world_nether
lp group builder permission set minecraft.command.gamemode.* false
lp group builder permission set minecraft.command.gamemode.creative true
lp group builder permission set minecraft.command.gamemode.survival true
execute in minecraft:the_nether run tp Bot 0.5 128 0.5
execute in minecraft:overworld run tp Bot 0.5 100 0.5
